note: Swedbank Lithuania's credit card page: the Classic Credit Card's administration fee is 2 euros a month; its interest is fixed individually when the card is issued, and the bank's own representative example uses a fixed 18% a year, the rate written here. The one-off issuance fee isn't counted.

sources.title: Swedbank (Lithuania), Credit cards
sources.said: The interest rate is fixed individually when issuing a credit card. ... For Classic and Gold credit cards: For a credit of EUR 1,500, at a fixed interest rate of 18% p.a., ... a monthly card administration fee (EUR 2/month for the Classic card, EUR 5/month for the Gold card)
